title: What are Nestlé commitments and progresses on packaging sustainability?
methodology: Company-reported packaging indicators for the end of 2025, including design criteria, virgin plastic reduction and recycled content.
potential_conflicts: Published by the company whose packaging performance is described.
limitations: Self-reported corporate indicators. 'Designed for recycling' does not mean that packaging is actually collected or recycled in each market. Reusable, recyclable and compostable are combined in one metric; the page itself notes that no single indicator fully describes circularity.
